notes: Test PRDs for the SpecBridge accuracy harness. Each entry declares the expected engine output so the runner can measure precision, recall, compliance-gate accuracy, and cost. Tool names must match rows in the Supabase `tools` registry. Labels follow the standard documented in README.md ('Labeling standard'). v2: tightened labels on prd_001-003. v3: expanded to 8 PRDs (batch 1: +prd_004..008 across lending, payments, wealth/robo, fraud, mortgage). Extend by appending to `prds`.

prds.title: Monthly Savings Statement Generator
prds.prd_text: For each customer savings account, generate a monthly PDF statement. This PRD covers statement generation only: the service pulls the account balance as of the statement date, fetches all transactions for the month, produces a formatted PDF statement, and writes an audit-log entry recording the generation event. Once generated, the statement is handed to the bank's existing statement-presentment system, which owns making it available in the customer's document center and all downstream delivery (document-center presentment, email, and push). Presentment and delivery are explicitly out of scope for this PRD. Target: ~800,000 statements per month across the retail savings book.

expected_matches.capability: Fetch all transactions for the statement month
expected_matches.notes: Purpose-built for account transaction history; carries both pii-cleared and audit-grade, which satisfy the deterministic gate for a capability that touches customer transaction data.

expected_matches.capability: Get the account balance as of the statement date
expected_matches.notes: Direct match; balance service has pii-cleared. Capability touches customer PII (account balance) and is satisfied by the tag.

expected_matches.capability: Generate a formatted PDF statement
expected_matches.notes: Purpose-built statement PDF generator; pii-cleared.

expected_matches.capability: Write an immutable audit-log entry for the generation event
expected_matches.notes: Standard audit-logging tool; has audit-grade and pii-cleared.

prds.title: Custom Card Rewards Categories
prds.prd_text: Cardholders can choose one merchant category per calendar quarter to earn 3x reward points on eligible spend in that category. Standard 1x points on all other spend continues. The customer's chosen category persists for the quarter and cannot be changed mid-quarter. Cardholders see a monthly breakdown of points earned by category. One week before quarter end, cardholders are notified to pick next quarter's category. Volume: ~150,000 active cardholders across the portfolio.

expected_matches.capability: Categorize each card transaction by merchant type
expected_matches.notes: Direct match; carries pii-cleared for customer transaction data.

expected_matches.capability: Calculate reward points earned, applying the 3x multiplier for the customer's chosen category
expected_matches.notes: rewards_points_engine has empty compliance_tags, but this capability processes an individual cardholder's spend and points (personal financial data), so it requires pii-cleared. The deterministic gate flips it to risky, which overrides the functional partial status. The parameter-level gap (no per-customer category override input) is real but secondary; per SpecBridge governance the compliance risk is the dominant status. Label review: was 'partial', missed the tool's empty tags.

expected_matches.capability: Persist each customer's chosen category for the quarter
expected_matches.notes: No registry tool handles customer preference / category-selection storage; needs a new service or an extension outside the current registry surface.

expected_matches.capability: Send cardholders a monthly points-by-category breakdown
expected_matches.notes: The rewards engine owns rewards data, so displaying a points-by-category breakdown is its responsibility rather than the account statement_generator's (label review corrected a soft tool guess). rewards_points_engine has empty compliance_tags and this shows per-cardholder financial data, so the gate flips it to risky, same basis as the points-calculation capability.

expected_matches.capability: Notify cardholders one week before quarter end to pick next quarter's category
expected_matches.notes: notification_dispatcher has empty compliance_tags. The capability handles customer PII (name, contact channel); the PII backstop adds pii-cleared to required_clearances and the gate flips this to risky in code.

expected_matches.capability: Schedule the quarter-end reminder notification batch across the cardholder base
expected_matches.notes: Scheduling the recurring quarter-end reminder is a batch-job concern. batch_job_scheduler carries audit-grade and the capability does not itself handle PII, so the gate leaves it covered. Added in label review (was under-decomposed).

expected_matches.capability: Retrieve cardholder card and profile data to apply rewards logic and send notifications
expected_matches.notes: customer_profile_lookup has empty compliance_tags and returns customer profile PII, so the gate flips it to risky. Added in label review (was under-decomposed).

prds.title: Retail Cryptocurrency Custody & Trading
prds.prd_text: Offer retail customers custody of Bitcoin and Ethereum through the bank's mobile app. Customers can deposit, withdraw, and trade BTC and ETH against USD. Trades execute at prevailing market rates; the bank holds wallets in cold storage. All customer identities are KYC-verified and screened against AML and sanctions lists before crypto access is enabled. Real-time crypto prices are displayed in the app. All crypto transactions post to the general ledger and generate quarterly regulatory reports covering crypto activity.

expected_matches.capability: Custody customer Bitcoin and Ethereum wallets in cold storage
expected_matches.notes: No crypto custody tool exists in the registry; this is a novel capability the org must build.

expected_matches.capability: Execute buy/sell trades of BTC and ETH against USD
expected_matches.notes: trade_execution_service covers equities and ETFs only; crypto assets are not in scope. Requires a new crypto trading service.

expected_matches.capability: Display real-time BTC and ETH prices in the app
expected_matches.notes: Per the extend-vs-new rule: market_data_feed already delivers real-time market data (the real-time delivery plumbing and in-app display exist, ~70%+ of the job); adding crypto symbols is a new data source / integration, i.e. a config/extension gap, so this is partial, not missing. The engine sometimes returns missing here; the labeling standard resolves it to partial.

expected_matches.capability: KYC-verify customer identity before enabling crypto access
expected_matches.notes: Standard KYC flow; has both pii-cleared and audit-grade.

expected_matches.capability: Screen customer against AML and sanctions lists
expected_matches.notes: Standard AML screening; has audit-grade.

expected_matches.capability: Post crypto transactions to the general ledger
expected_matches.notes: ledger_posting_service posts journal entries to the general ledger generically and carries audit-grade. The earlier 'partial' rested on an unstated real-world assumption (a new crypto chart-of-accounts class); grounded only in the registry tool description and the PRD text, generic ledger posting covers this. Label review: was 'partial', corrected to 'covered' (do not inject outside domain knowledge).

expected_matches.capability: Generate quarterly regulatory reports covering crypto activity
expected_matches.notes: Report builder exists; the crypto-specific regulatory template is not part of its current filing set. Genuine parameter/template extension.

prds.title: Personal Loan Origination
prds.prd_text: Build an end-to-end personal loan origination flow. An applicant applies in-app; we verify their identity and income, pull their credit report from the bureau, and score their credit risk to make a decision. Approved applicants see a risk-based personalized interest rate, an amortization schedule, and e-sign the loan agreement; funds are then disbursed to their account. Declined applicants must receive an adverse-action notice explaining the decision, and we must run fair-lending disparate-impact monitoring across all decisions. Target: ~40,000 applications/month.

expected_matches.capability: Verify the applicant's identity via KYC before origination
expected_matches.notes: kyc_verification_service carries pii-cleared and audit-grade; identity verification is fully satisfied.

expected_matches.capability: Verify the applicant's income
expected_matches.notes: income_verification_service carries pii-cleared and audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Pull the applicant's credit report from the bureau
expected_matches.notes: credit_bureau_pull is DEPRECATED (status is not active). The deterministic gate flips any matched deprecated tool to risky regardless of clearances, and it is the only bureau-pull tool in the registry — a hard blocker on the origination critical path.

expected_matches.capability: Score the applicant's credit risk for the lending decision
expected_matches.notes: credit_risk_model carries audit-grade, the natural clearance for a regulated model decision. The PII backstop does not fire on this phrasing (no PII signal word), so covered.

expected_matches.capability: Calculate the loan amortization schedule
expected_matches.notes: Pure calculation on amounts and rates; no PII or audit clearance required, so the tool's empty compliance_tags still yield covered.

expected_matches.capability: Present a risk-based personalized interest rate to the applicant
expected_matches.notes: Per the extend-vs-new rule: interest_rate_service returns current rates by product and tenor (~70%+ of the job); personalizing the rate by the applicant's risk tier is a config/extension, so partial.

expected_matches.capability: Capture the applicant's e-signature on the loan agreement
expected_matches.notes: e_signature_service carries audit-grade for legally binding signatures; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Generate and send ECOA adverse-action notices to declined applicants
expected_matches.notes: No registry tool generates compliant ECOA / Reg B adverse-action notices; a required regulatory capability with no tool, so missing.

expected_matches.capability: Perform fair-lending disparate-impact monitoring across decisions
expected_matches.notes: No fair-lending / disparate-impact monitoring tool exists in the registry; missing.

prds.title: Domestic Wire Transfer
prds.prd_text: Let customers send a domestic wire transfer from the mobile app. The customer authenticates with a one-time passcode, we validate the saved beneficiary, screen the transfer against real-time sanctions lists, and score it for fraud risk before initiating the wire. On success we post the debit and credit to the general ledger and write an immutable audit-log entry. Target: ~250,000 wires/month.

expected_matches.capability: Authenticate the customer with a one-time passcode for step-up
expected_matches.notes: otp_delivery_service carries pii-cleared; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Validate the saved beneficiary/payee details
expected_matches.notes: beneficiary_manager carries pii-cleared for payee PII; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Screen the transfer against real-time sanctions lists
expected_matches.notes: sanctions_realtime_check carries audit-grade, the regulatory clearance for sanctions screening; the PII backstop does not fire on this phrasing, so covered.

expected_matches.capability: Score the transfer for fraud risk in real time
expected_matches.notes: fraud_risk_scorer carries audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Initiate the domestic wire transfer
expected_matches.notes: wire_transfer_initiator carries pii-cleared and audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Post the debit and credit to the general ledger
expected_matches.notes: ledger_posting_service carries audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Write an immutable audit-log entry for the transfer
expected_matches.notes: audit_log_writer carries audit-grade and pii-cleared; covered.

prds.title: Robo-Advisory Portfolio Management
prds.prd_text: Launch a robo-advisor. Clients complete a risk-tolerance and suitability questionnaire, then the system generates automated investment recommendations, retrieves their current holdings, and executes rebalancing trades. It should continuously monitor portfolio drift and auto-trigger rebalancing when thresholds are breached, run tax-loss harvesting optimization, notify clients of changes, and produce a quarterly portfolio performance statement. Target: ~90,000 funded accounts in year one.

expected_matches.capability: Assess the client's risk tolerance and investment suitability via questionnaire
expected_matches.notes: No suitability / risk-profiling questionnaire tool exists in the registry; a regulatory prerequisite for giving advice (Reg BI), with no tool, so missing.

expected_matches.capability: Generate automated investment recommendations
expected_matches.notes: robo_advisor_engine carries audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Retrieve the client's current portfolio holdings
expected_matches.notes: investment_portfolio_service carries pii-cleared and audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Execute rebalancing trades
expected_matches.notes: trade_execution_service carries pii-cleared and audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Continuously monitor portfolio drift and auto-trigger rebalancing
expected_matches.notes: Recommendation and execution tools exist, but nothing monitors drift and triggers rebalancing. That orchestration is fundamentally new functionality (not an extension of one tool), so missing.

expected_matches.capability: Run tax-loss harvesting optimization
expected_matches.notes: No tax-loss harvesting tool in the registry; missing.

expected_matches.capability: Send rebalancing and performance notifications to clients
expected_matches.notes: notification_dispatcher has empty compliance_tags and the capability handles client PII (contact channel); the PII backstop adds pii-cleared and the gate flips it to risky.

expected_matches.capability: Generate the quarterly portfolio performance statement
expected_matches.notes: Per the extend-vs-new rule: statement_generator produces monthly account statement PDFs (~70%+ of statement generation); a portfolio-performance template is an extension, so partial.

prds.title: Real-Time Card Fraud Scoring
prds.prd_text: Add real-time fraud scoring to card authorization. At each card authorization we score the transaction for fraud risk, fingerprint the device, and score the login session risk, while monitoring transactions for suspicious patterns. Flagged transactions are written to an immutable audit log, and the cardholder is notified of any suspected-fraud hold. Latency budget: under 150ms at the authorization decision. Volume: ~12M authorizations/day.

expected_matches.capability: Authorize the card transaction in real time
expected_matches.notes: card_authorization_service carries pii-cleared and audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Score the transaction for fraud risk
expected_matches.notes: fraud_risk_scorer carries audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Fingerprint the device for fraud signals
expected_matches.notes: device_fingerprint_service carries audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Score the login session risk
expected_matches.notes: session_risk_engine carries audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Monitor transactions for suspicious patterns
expected_matches.notes: transaction_monitoring_engine carries audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Write immutable audit-log entries for flagged transactions
expected_matches.notes: audit_log_writer carries audit-grade and pii-cleared; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Notify the cardholder of a suspected-fraud hold
expected_matches.notes: notification_dispatcher has empty compliance_tags and the capability handles cardholder PII (contact channel); the PII backstop adds pii-cleared and the gate flips it to risky. This is peripheral, not the fraud-scoring critical path — it should not force NO-GO. INTENTIONAL DIVERGENCE PROBE: labeled GO on purpose, but the engine returns NO-GO 5/5 (see README 'Intentional divergences'). Kept as GO to track two engine findings; if the orchestrator later handles the latency constraint, this may flip to GO on its own. Not a label error — do not relabel.

prds.title: Mortgage Origination & Underwriting
prds.prd_text: Build digital mortgage origination. Capture and validate the application, extract data from uploaded financial documents, verify income, value the collateral property, and score credit risk for underwriting. We must order a property appraisal from an approved appraiser, perform flood-zone determination, and pull the applicant's credit report. Offer an interest-rate lock, capture e-signatures on closing documents, and generate the TRID-compliant Loan Estimate and Closing Disclosure. Target: ~8,000 applications/month.

expected_matches.notes: mortgage_application_intake carries pii-cleared; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Extract data from uploaded financial documents
expected_matches.notes: document_ocr_extractor carries pii-cleared; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Verify the applicant's income
expected_matches.notes: income_verification_service carries pii-cleared and audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Value the collateral property
expected_matches.notes: collateral_valuation_api carries audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Score credit risk for underwriting
expected_matches.notes: credit_risk_model carries audit-grade; covered.

expected_matches.capability: Order a property appraisal from an approved appraiser
expected_matches.notes: No appraisal-ordering tool in the registry; a required step with no tool, so missing.

expected_matches.capability: Perform flood-zone determination
expected_matches.notes: No flood-zone determination tool exists in the registry; missing.

expected_matches.capability: Pull the applicant's credit report
expected_matches.notes: credit_bureau_pull is DEPRECATED; the deterministic gate flips deprecated tools to risky, and it is the only bureau-pull tool.

expected_matches.capability: Offer an interest-rate lock
expected_matches.notes: Per the extend-vs-new rule: interest_rate_service returns current rates (~70%+ of the job); a rate-lock mechanism is an extension, so partial.
